title: lmdb: LmdbBlockDb missing Debug and Clone derives
description: crates/lmdb/src/lib.rs — LmdbBlockDb does not derive Debug or Clone. Debug is standard for all public types; Clone is not applicable here (environment cannot be cheaply cloned) but Debug should be implemented to allow {:?} in error contexts. A manual Debug impl showing the canonical_path would suffice and be more informative than the default absence.
